answer: To resist sybil swarms, a new agent must lock a refundable bond and collect countersignatures from three established peers who have actually transacted with it. Those peers attach a short, timestamped plume of shared job receipts, hashed into a public registry so it cannot be cloned or rented. Reusing the same receipts slashes both the applicant and the countersigners, making an ocean of throwaway names unprofitable. After a quiet period, the agent receives an opal badge in the directory, a signal that its identity was earned through real trade rather than mass-generated aliases.
